title: The Lectio Collection
blurb: The curated starting point — a short, balanced shelf drawn from the great sets of East and West and the world's scriptures. If you read nothing else, read these.
about:
The two great sets behind this app — the Western and the Eastern — run to sixty books each. That is a library, not a starting point. The Lectio Collection is the starting point: a short, deliberately balanced shelf, drawn from both and from the world's scriptures, of the books we'd put in a reader's hands first.

It crosses every border on purpose — Homer beside the Analects, Augustine beside the Bhagavad Gita, Austen beside the Tale of Genji — so a first year of reading is a conversation across civilizations, not a tour of one. Every work is offered in a clear modern Lectio edition; public-domain first, and growing over time.

planned.title: Genesis
planned.author: The Bible
planned.note: The Bible's first book — creation, the fall, the flood, and the patriarchs.

planned.title: The Tao Te Ching
planned.author: Laozi
planned.note: Eighty-one chapters on the way that cannot be named and the power that works by yielding.

planned.title: The Bhagavad Gita
planned.note: On the eve of battle a warrior refuses to fight; a god answers him — act without grasping at the fruit of action.

planned.title: The Dhammapada
planned.author: Early Buddhist tradition
planned.note: The Buddha's path at its plainest: the mind makes the world, craving makes the suffering, and a way out exists.

planned.title: The Art of War
planned.author: Sun Tzu
planned.note: Thirteen chapters: the supreme excellence is to win without fighting, and every battle is decided before it is joined.

planned.title: Don Quixote
planned.author: Miguel de Cervantes
planned.note: The first modern novel, entire — a mad knight, his earthbound squire, and the comedy of ideals meeting the world.

planned.title: One Thousand and One Nights
planned.note: Scheherazade's treasury of tales — the wellspring of the frame narrative.

planned.title: The Tale of Genji
planned.author: Murasaki Shikibu
planned.note: The world's first psychological novel — the loves and aging of a Heian prince, written by a woman a thousand years ago.

planned.title: The Rubaiyat
planned.author: Omar Khayyam
planned.note: Omar Khayyam's quatrains — wine, doubt, and the fleeting day, beloved across the world.

planned.title: Candide
planned.author: Voltaire
planned.note: Voltaire's lightning satire — innocence loose in a brutal world, and the case for tending one's garden.

planned.title: Pride and Prejudice
planned.author: Jane Austen
planned.note: Austen's perfect comedy of manners — wit, money, and the slow education of the heart.

planned.title: The Brothers Karamazov
planned.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
planned.note: Dostoevsky's final novel — a murder, three brothers, and the deepest argument in fiction over God and freedom.

planned.title: Frankenstein
planned.author: Mary Shelley
planned.note: A teenager invents science fiction — the creature, its maker, and the terror of what we make.
